やったこと・やること: what we have done, what comes next
実際にある現場の一覧です。: A list of the actual projects on the ground.
進行中・完了・これからの3つに分けています。: Sorted into three groups: ongoing, complete, and upcoming.
2026〜 ｜ with 自然農法無の会 ｜ 昭和村: 2026– ｜ with Munokai Natural Farm ｜ Showa Village
水源の郷に、新たな自然農法の農場を一から立ち上げる。稲作・大豆・畑作の拠点として: Starting a new natural farm from scratch in a village at the headwaters. We are developing it as a base for rice, soybeans, and vegetables.
数年放置されていた田を開墾し、稲作を再開。水の循環のいちばん上流にあたる水源の郷: Clearing paddies left idle for several years and bringing rice back. This village sits at the very top of the water cycle, at the source.
子連れ家族を迎えるための古民家再生。皆が寝泊まりできる拠点として整備を進めていま: Restoring an old house to welcome families with children. We are developing it as a base where everyone can stay overnight.
2025〜 ｜ with 岩代国風結び ｜ 会津美里町・伊佐須美神社: 2025– ｜ with Iwashiro-kuni Kazemusubi ｜ Isasumi Shrine, Aizumisato
水源・沢・山と土を整える。伊佐須美神社の社叢（杜）の再生を含め、岩代国風結びと通: Caring for springs, streams, mountains, and soil. Year-round work with Iwashiro-kuni Kazemusubi, including the restoration of the sacred grove at Isasumi Shrine.
中古農機・設備の入手から修理、施工まで。中山間地に合う小型・低予算の機械という前: From sourcing used machinery and equipment to repair and installation. This underpins our premise of small, low-cost machines suited to hilly terrain.
随時 ｜ 会津・首都圏: Ongoing ｜ Aizu and the Tokyo area
小学校の授業や高校生の合宿、大学との共同研究。村を、学びの場として開いています。: Elementary school classes, high school camps, and joint research with universities. We open the village as a place for learning.
通年 ｜ with 自然農法無の会 ｜ 農繁期に厚く: Year-round ｜ with Munokai Natural Farm ｜ mainly in busy seasons
田植えや稲刈りなど、人手の要る時期に数日から。人数の上限は設けていません。: From a few days at a time, during busy periods such as rice planting and harvest. There is no limit on numbers.
催し ｜ with 自然農法無の会 ｜ 年1回・秋: Event ｜ with Munokai Natural Farm ｜ once a year, in autumn
その年の実りを、関わってくださった皆さんと分かち合う日。パートナーの方は宿泊での: A day to share the year's harvest with everyone who took part. Partners are welcome to stay overnight.
初年度に総額1.6億円を調達: Raised ¥160 million in the first year
事業構想を400名超に直接プレゼンし、一年で民間パートナーさんが37組生まれまし: We presented the business vision directly to more than 400 people, and within a year 37 private partners had joined.
解体寸前だった築250年超の古民家を、会津の職人と2年越しで再生。SHINDOの: A 250-year-old house on the verge of demolition, restored over two years with Aizu craftsmen. This is where SHINDO began.
大豆の不耕起・無除草栽培に成功: Succeeded in no-till, no-weeding soybean cultivation
人力播種機で約7アールを2時間で播種。一度も除草せず、県の慣行平均を上回る収量を: Sowed about 700 m² in two hours with a hand-pushed seeder. Without weeding once, the yield exceeded the prefectural conventional average.
2026年 ｜ with （株）トレードオン ｜ 昭和村: 2026 ｜ with Trade-On Co., Ltd. ｜ Showa Village
小野川にあった、外壁がボロボロでゴミ屋敷状態だった大きな鉄骨倉庫。掃除から外壁工: A large steel-frame warehouse in Onogawa, its walls crumbling and its interior piled with junk. From cleaning to wall work and concrete repairs, we brought it back into use.
会社関係者65名が全国から集まり、昭和村の耕作放棄地の再生に取り組みました。: Sixty-five people from one company gathered from across Japan to restore abandoned farmland in Showa Village.
大豆の不耕起栽培用・ローラークリンパーの製造: Building a roller crimper for no-till soybeans
草を刈らずに倒して敷き草にする、不耕起栽培の要となる道具を、輸入せずに自作しまし: A key tool for no-till farming that flattens cover crops into mulch instead of mowing them. We built it ourselves rather than importing one.
2025〜 ｜ with （株）トレードオン ｜ 検証段階: 2025– ｜ with Trade-On Co., Ltd. ｜ in testing
中小規模でも参入できる小型・低予算の播種機と、不耕起用田植え機の改造。トレードオ: A small, low-cost seeder that small and mid-sized farms can afford, and a rice transplanter converted for no-till. Developed jointly with Trade-On.
都市に暮らす人が通年で無の会に通い、営農を支える仕組みを実装。2年目を迎え、新し: A system in which city residents come to Munokai throughout the year to support the farm. Now in its second year, it has welcomed new members.
2025年度 ｜ with （株）志木 ｜ 会津美里町: FY2025 ｜ with Shiki Co., Ltd. ｜ Aizumisato
蔵を改修して中規模の備蓄倉庫を揃え、夏場でも2.4tの玄米を冷蔵保管することが可: By converting a storehouse into a mid-sized warehouse, we can now keep 2.4 tons of brown rice refrigerated even through summer.
人力播種機を手に社員が畑へ。不耕起・無除草の大豆栽培の作付けを、人の手で支えまし: Company staff headed into the fields with hand-pushed seeders, supporting the planting of no-till, no-weeding soybeans by hand.
with 茂木綾子＆佐々木直也 ｜ 会津美里町: with Ayako Mogi & Naoya Sasaki ｜ Aizumisato
コンセプトムービー「SHINDO 2025」を製作。映像監督の茂木さんは2026: Produced the concept film SHINDO 2025. Director Ayako Mogi moved to Aizu in 2026.
土かまど・アースオーブンづくり: Building an earthen stove and earth oven
17日間で延べ100人以上が土を練り、理空の長屋門の土間に、二口の土かまどと、ア: Over 17 days, more than 100 people in total kneaded clay to build a two-burner earthen stove and an earth oven in the earthen-floored gatehouse at Rikū.
多様な背景をもつ人が円座に集い、対話と身体感覚から「和」を生み出す4日間のプログ: A four-day program in which people from diverse backgrounds sit in a circle and create harmony through dialogue and bodily awareness.
稲作の面積拡大と、家族の受け入れ: Expanding rice acreage and welcoming families
作付を広げ、迎え入れる家族を増やす。空き家の再生を2軒目、3軒目へ。: Plant more land and welcome more families. Move on to restoring a second and third empty house.
小野川地区の耕作放棄地について、水路を含めた農地再生のノウハウを溜めながら。: Restoring abandoned farmland in the Onogawa area while building up know-how, including on waterways.
空き家の再生 5軒以上: Restoring five or more empty houses
地元の大工とともに、できる限り地域の資材で。: With local carpenters and, as far as possible, local materials.
滞在する人が健やかになる家を。: Houses that make the people who stay in them healthier.
共育の場の立ち上げ: Launching a place for shared learning
カフェのような営みを土台としながら、共に生き抜く力・創り出す力・支え合う力を育む: Built on something like a café, a place to nurture the ability to survive, to create, and to support one another.
暮らしのOSを、村の中で回す: Running the operating system of life within the village
食・住・エネルギー・健康・共育の5領域を、ひとつの集落の中で連動させる段階へ。: The stage at which the five areas — food, housing, energy, health, and shared learning — work together within a single community.
拠点「理空」に滞在し、自然と身体感覚に立ち返る数日間のプログラム。: A program of several days at Rikū, returning to nature and to the senses of the body.
安全性・再現性・法的適合性を確かめる、慎重な第一歩の段階です。: A careful first step: confirming safety, reproducibility, and legal compliance.
